│spec-kanban test · any key closes                      │
│                                                       │
│Board                                                  │
│  h/l j/k      column, card                            │
│  gg/G         first/last card                         │
│  ctrl+d/u     half page down/up                       │
│  1-5          column by number                        │
│  enter        details                                 │
│  e            edit tasks                              │
│  s/v/a        start, verify, archive                  │
│  space        mark for a wave                         │
│  / n/N        filter by name, next/previous match     │
│  esc          clear the filter, else marks, else close│
│  r            reload                                  │
│  ?            this help                               │
│  q            close                                   │
│                                                       │
│Filter prompt                                          │
│  enter/esc    keep/clear the filter                   │
│  backspace    delete, close when empty                │
│                                                       │
│Details                                                │
│  1-4, tab     switch document                         │
│  shift+tab    previous document                       │
│  j/k gg/G     scroll, top/end                         │
│  ctrl+d/u     half page down/up                       │
│  e            edit the document                       │
│  q/esc        back to the Board                       │
